phrase: A tech giant's own AI search cut its ad revenue, and its stock lost half a trillion dollars. Another company offered buyouts to 60,000 workers for AI.
phraseAlternatives: AI search just cost one company half a trillion dollars in stock value. A rival is paying 60,000 workers to leave instead.
A company's own AI tool quietly drained its ad revenue, and investors noticed fast. Another firm is clearing out tens of thousands of jobs for the same technology.
Half a trillion dollars vanished from one company's stock after its AI cut into ad sales. Another offered buyouts to 60,000 workers to make room for AI.
alt: A smaller company building sits on a shrinking coin stack, marked by a dashed outline and yellow arrow showing the drop, topped by a cheerful robot, beside a chart whose line falls off the edge, labeled Stock Falls. Across a dashed divider, a worker carries an envelope away from a darker, empty building, leaving behind an empty chair that now holds a small glowing box, labeled Jobs Cut.

brief.concept: A company perches on a shrinking stack of coins under a cheerful search-bar robot, its stock arrow falling through a cracked chart, while next door workers walk out past an empty chair holding a glowing AI box.
brief.metaphor: The AI that was supposed to make the money is quietly eating the money, while the workers who used to do the work are replaced by an empty chair with a light in it.

cast.who: a company building standing on a tall stack of coins that is visibly shrinking
a small search-bar robot sitting happily on top of the shrinking coin stack
a falling stock arrow poking through a cracked chart beside the building
office workers walking out of a second building's open door, one holding an envelope
a small glowing AI box left alone in an empty desk chair behind them

brief.composition: Split the frame into two linked scenes on the same blueprint grid. Left: the company building on its shrinking coin stack, the search-bar robot perched on top, the stock arrow falling through a cracked chart. Right: a second building's doorway with workers filing out, one clutching an envelope, and an empty desk chair behind them holding a small glowing AI box. One yellow highlight on the falling arrow and the glowing box ties the two halves together. Keep it to these 4-5 shapes, no added text beyond small chart/arrow labels.
brief.alt: A building sits on a shrinking pile of coins with a small robot perched on top as a stock arrow falls through a cracked chart; beside it, office workers walk out of another building's door past an empty chair where a small glowing AI box now sits alone.
